knownLimitation: T09 reuses the existing quiz-admin allowlist as the repository's current general administrative gate. T09 does not introduce a new role or permission model.

environments.backend: Local Docker Compose api-verify; Go 1.23 Linux
environments.http: Fiber app.Test with sqlmock and route middleware chain

checks.name: docker-vet
checks.command: docker compose --profile verify run --rm api-verify go vet ./...

checks.name: docker-test
checks.command: docker compose --profile verify run --rm api-verify go test ./... -count=1

checks.name: docker-race
checks.command: docker compose --profile verify run --rm api-verify go test -race ./models ./controllers/api/v1 ./pkg/structs -count=1

checks.name: docker-build
checks.command: docker compose --profile verify run --rm api-verify go build ./...
